description: Generate the draft-11 180-octet Proof-of-Time Record v2 core. TLS binding proof is computed only after a live TLS session exists.

holderAuthData.description: 32-octet holder public key or PSK digest encoded as hex

holderAuthType.description: 0x01 Ed25519 holder key (default) or 0x02 shared secret

tsTaiUs.description: TAI timestamp in microseconds as a decimal string

name: pot_generate_v2
